hook: 30 minutes. That's all it took to build this whole product launch animation with Claude Opus 5.5 and After Effects.
caption:
Claude Opus 5.5 built this whole product launch animation in 30 minutes 🤯

No animator, no manual keyframing. Claude wrote the After Effects expressions and structured the entire scene, from a blank project to a finished, on-brand motion piece.

This is what AI coding models can already do outside of writing code: motion design, whole creative pipelines, start to finish.

Would you trust AI to build your next launch video? Yes or no 👇
